coverage.main: Read all nine pages of arXiv 1908.08705v1 (23 August 2019; the only arXiv version), including Sections 1-5, Figures 1-8, footnotes and references.
coverage.supplement: No appendix or supplement is included or linked. The ICPR 2020 proceedings version (corpus venue) was not retrieved; judgments rest on arXiv v1. The linked code and video are artifacts, not paper text.
coverage.excluded_results: Figures 5 and 7 evaluate the attacked LResNet100E-IR model itself (fixed and varied shooting conditions); Figures 1-4 and 6 are illustrations. Section 4.2 sticker localization is a white-box digital observation without reported values.

result_groups.population: Printed physical stickers for 10 volunteers (from the Section 4.4 fixed-condition photos), evaluated on LResNet50E, LResNet34E and MobileFaceNet from the InsightFace model zoo
result_groups.outcome: difference between baseline (hat) and final (adversarial sticker) cosine similarity to the ground-truth embedding, shown as boxplots
result_groups.evidence: Section 4.3 explicitly declines to report a dodging success percentage because success depends on a deployment threshold; Figure 8 plots continuous similarity differences. No clean-correct or source-success event is defined, and every volunteer's sticker is evaluated.

f1.evidence: A per-person baseline similarity with a plain hat is used, which is a relevant clean reference for the similarity outcome, but no clean recognition accuracy is reported for the source or transfer models.

f2.evidence: No rate or clean-correct denominator exists for the continuous similarity outcome.

f3.evidence: Stickers for all ten volunteers are evaluated; no source-success event or threshold is defined, by explicit design choice, so conditioning cannot be coded yes or no.

f4.evidence: Ten persons are stated, but outcomes are boxplots of similarity differences with no rates or per-person values printed.

f5.evidence: The sticker (400 x 900 pixels before projection) is optimized with cosine-similarity plus TV loss and no norm constraint; the paper contrasts L-infinity attacks with L0-style physical patches. This is an explicit physical-patch threat model, not an omitted radius.

f6.evidence: The linked MIT repository provides attack, alignment and demo code and CASIA centroids, relying on InsightFace model-zoo weights. The volunteer photographs and printed-sticker captures needed to recompute Figure 8 are not released (reasonably, given they are images of people), so the original transfer outcomes cannot be recomputed from the release.

artifact_checks.result: Cloned and pinned (25 tracked files). Attack pipeline (TF/MXNet cosine models, STN projection), face preparation, Demo with MTCNN alignment and CASIA centroids, MXNet-to-TF notebook. No volunteer images, stickers or per-person similarity records. Not executed.

bounds_checks.reason: Cosine-similarity differences are not misclassification probabilities; the paper explicitly avoids a thresholded success rate. Not applicable.

limitations: Non-blind evidence audit; physical face-recognition similarity outcome recorded in the non-classification stratum.
ICPR version not inspected; no execution.
